samples.summary: The new slide-text block validation is reachable around: only slides[*].elements is walked, while layouts[*].staticElements, masters[*] elements and slides[*].notes carry the same docs Blocks through the same PUT into the same layout engine and exporters, unvalidated.
samples.evidence: assertValidSlidesBody only loops b.slides (docs-content.controller.ts:459-462) and assertValidSlide merely checks Array.isArray(s.notes) (line 490). But Slide.notes: Block[] (packages/slides/src/model/presentation.ts:45) and layout/master staticElements (packages/slides/src/model/layout.ts:70,80,105) hold the same docs Block / element shapes the new assertValidTextBodyBlocks guards for slides[*].elements. writeSlidesRoot (packages/backend/src/yorkie/slides-tree.ts:93) bulk-assigns layouts, masters and notes verbatim, so the exact out-of-range style.alignment or non-finite marginTop the diff now rejects via slides[i].elements[j].data.blocks still reaches the deck via layouts[k].staticElements[j].data.blocks or slides[i].notes[n].style on the same endpoint.

samples.summary: The docs arm still does not validate the named-style registry (styles), which writeDocsRoot persists verbatim and whose spacing numbers feed the same layout engine the new block-style guard protects.
samples.evidence: assertValidDocsBody validates blocks/header/footer only; writeDocsRoot serializes document.styles straight to root.stylesJson (packages/backend/src/yorkie/docs-tree.ts:543-546) and materializeBlockSpacing later reads those numbers into block styles, so a NaN/absurd spacing in styles bypasses the finite-number guard added for style.marginTop.

samples.summary: A third hand-rolled encoder of block-style Tree attributes was left un-migrated to the new shared codec, contradicting the invariant the change documents ("neither side keeps a copy").
samples.evidence: initialDocsRoot() writes alignment/lineHeight/marginTop/marginBottom/textIndent/marginLeft literally (packages/frontend/src/types/docs-document.ts:55-64) instead of serializeBlockStyleAttrs, while docs/design/docs/docs-collaboration.md:102-109 asserts exactly two writers both importing model/crdt-attrs.ts. It happens to agree today, so nothing breaks now — it is the drift surface the change set out to remove.

samples.summary: Design doc names a helper that does not exist: it documents removeCellNodeStyle while the code introduces removeNodeStyle (nested design docs are not link/symbol-checked by any lane).
samples.evidence: docs/design/docs/docs-tables.md:184 says "removeCellNodeStyle (yorkie-doc-store.ts) converts the path to an index"; the function defined at packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:273 is removeNodeStyle. docs/design/docs/docs-intent-preserving-edits.md:240 still describes applyCellSpan as using removeStyleByPath, which it no longer does.

samples.summary: The endpoint's documented "writers are identity on the JSON shape for valid input" echo contract is now false for input classes the change explicitly starts accepting (partial style: {}, absent header.marginFromEdge).
samples.evidence: putContent echoes the request body back (docs-content.controller.ts:161-175) on the claim that the writer is identity, but serializeBlockStyleAttrs / serializeMarginFromEdgeAttrs now omit absent fields and the reader fills DEFAULT_BLOCK_STYLE / DEFAULT_HEADER_MARGIN_FROM_EDGE, so a PUT of {style:{}} (accepted by the new test at docs-content.controller.spec.ts:484) returns {} while the following GET returns the fully defaulted style. Any CLI flow that diffs PUT response against a later `docs content` fetch sees a mismatch.

samples.summary: PPTX export gained runtime (non-type) imports of the browser @wafflebase/docs entry, weakening the DOM-free guarantee that packages/slides/src/node.ts asserts for exportPptx.
samples.evidence: packages/slides/src/export/pptx/color.ts:1 and packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:3 now `import { toRgbHexColor } from '@wafflebase/docs'` (previously text.ts had only `import type`, which is erased). packages/slides/src/node.ts:170-171 re-exports exportPptx with the comment "PPTX export — DOM-free; safe for Node consumers without a polyfill", and packages/cli/src/slides/pptx-export.ts:1 consumes it under Node, where '@wafflebase/docs' resolves to the browser entry (packages/docs/src/index.ts:105-183 pulls view/editor, doc-canvas, canvas-measurer). The backend is insulated by its tsconfig/jest path map to docs/src/node.ts (packages/backend/tsconfig.json:15, package.json:114) and the CLI already value-imports the docs root elsewhere, so this may be benign today — confirming would need a Node smoke import of @wafflebase/slides/node.

verdict.reason: The new slide-block-style validation is bypassable through sibling fields of the same PUT payload, and I could find no counterexample anywhere in the request path. assertValidSlidesBody (docs-content.controller.ts:452-462) only Array.isArray-checks themes/masters/layouts and then walks slides alone; assertValidSlide (docs-content.controller.ts:485-501) Array.isArray-checks notes but only recurses into elements, so no block style under layouts[*].staticElements, layouts[*].placeholders, masters[*], or slides[*].notes is ever seen by assertValidBlockStyle. There is no second layer: putContent takes `@Body() body: unknown` (docs-content.controller.ts:130) so the global ValidationPipe (packages/backend/src/main.ts:65-66) has no DTO metatype to enforce, and writeSlidesRoot assigns masters/layouts/slides verbatim onto the Yorkie root (packages/backend/src/yorkie/slides-tree.ts:102-105). Nothing downstream sanitizes either: normalizeBlockStyle is a bare spread (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:272-274) and is exactly what the slides text renderer applies (packages/slides/src/view/canvas/text-renderer.ts:261-264); migrateLayout passes staticElements through untouched (packages/slides/src/model/migrate.ts:115) and migrateSlide passes notes through untouched (migrate.ts:128), unlike migrateGuide which does finite-check (migrate.ts:100-107). The unvalidated regions are live: Layout.staticElements/Slide.notes are the same Element/Block shapes (packages/slides/src/model/presentation.ts:45,62), staticElements is rendered (packages/slides/src/view/canvas/layout-preview.ts:41,59) and notes is exported as Block[] to PPTX (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/index.ts:348-350, packages/slides/src/export/pptx/slide.ts:205). That is a guard with a reachable bypass on the same endpoint, in-lane and major for the blast-radius rubric.
